description: Find and research your next customers with Clay.

defaultPrompt: Find me sales leaders at Acme
Build a workflow to qualify inbound leads
interface.longDescription: Find and research your next customers. Find emails, send customized outreach, build workflows to qualify leads, and more with Clay.

negative.description: Unsupported search filter. Expected: Explains that Clay Search does not support email-address filtering; does not fabricate matches.
negative.prompt: Find people whose email is exactly review-test@example.com using only Clay Search.

negative.description: Contradictory filters. Expected: Identifies the contradiction or returns zero matches without dropping either condition.
negative.prompt: Find companies with more than 1,000 employees and fewer than 10 employees at the same time.

negative.description: Missing audience. Expected: Reports that the audience was not found, rather than reporting zero members or substituting another audience.
negative.prompt: How many people are in the audience named OPENAI_REVIEW_NONEXISTENT_7F92C1? Don’t substitute another audience.

positive.prompt: Find five people currently working as software engineers at Microsoft. Don’t ask follow-up questions.

positive.expected_behavior: Displays five companies matching Clay’s stored industry, headquarters, and size filters.
positive.prompt: Find five software companies headquartered in the United States with 51–200 employees. Don’t ask follow-up questions.

positive.expected_behavior: Reports separate totals for workspace people and company records.
positive.prompt: How many people and companies are in my Audiences?

positive.expected_behavior: Creates and displays a valid draft with the website input connected to the research step. Does not publish or run it.
positive.prompt: Build a draft workflow named ‘Company Research Test’ that accepts a company website and uses AI research to produce a one-sentence description of what the company does. Show me the workflow. Don’t publish or run it.

positive.expected_behavior: Saves and displays a two-email draft with a three-day follow-up and no recipients. Does not send anything.
positive.prompt: Create a draft campaign named ‘Review Outreach Test’ with two emails introducing a fictional meeting-scheduling product called MeetSimple to sales leaders. Include subjects and bodies, with the follow-up three days later. Don’t add recipients or send anything.
